hints.title: Multi-Die Face Summation Obstacle
hints.text: Rolling n dice each with k faces produces totals between n and n * k. How can advancing die by die track the cumulative number of ways to form each sum up to target modulo 10^9 + 7?

hints.title: Die-by-Die Face Sum Invariant
hints.text: The number of ways to form sum s using d dice is the sum of ways to form s - f using d - 1 dice, for all face values f from 1 to min(k, s).

hints.title: 1D Rolling Target Array Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a 1D array of size target + 1 with 0s, setting entry 0 to 1. For each die from 1 to n, allocate a new array. For each target sum s from die up to min(target, die * k), sum the previous array entries at s - f for f from 1 to k modulo 10^9 + 7. Swap arrays after each die and return entry target.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates over N dice, T target sums, and K face choices with 1D array storage.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching simulates K^N combinations which times out immediately.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing only two rows of length T + 1 keeps space bounded at O(T).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pruning impossible targets target < n or target > n * k before looping.
